channel.title: MARGIN — Kai’s adventure journal
channel.description: Fictional adventure stories by Kai. An Alienway Production demo.

item.title: The trail I nearly skipped.
item.description: I nearly traded this walk for another afternoon indoors. Then the coast gave me a reason to keep going.

item.title: My desk has an ocean view.
item.description: Some of my favourite travel notes begin at a café table, with a cup going cold and boats moving in the harbour.

item.title: Coffee tastes better outside.
item.description: A tent, a metal mug and the first light on the mountains. This is my kind of slow morning.

item.title: Colour around every corner.
item.description: I went looking for a photograph and came back with a new way of seeing streets I thought I knew.

item.title: Take the coast road.
item.description: The quickest route was inland. I chose the road with more sea, more stops and fewer reasons to hurry.

item.title: A beginner’s kind of morning.
item.description: I did not arrive at the beach looking like I knew what I was doing. That was part of the point.
